description: Search Personal Health Data listings by data type, keyword, and demographics. Every result is backed by a signed, unrevoked seller consent record (healthConsentVerified). Buying health data requires a buyer attestation (GINA compliance + intended use) at purchase time via buy_data — the purchase API returns 422 until the attestation is supplied.
